- Improved opening the window from the tray, which now responds faster by sharing one process with the background host
- Improved memory use while hidden, which now releases graphics resources after five seconds while preserving pages for reopening
- Fixed an issue with restoring a hidden window that previously caused the close button to briefly flash its old hover color
- Fixed an issue with remote subscription downloads that previously timed out too early on slower servers; downloads now have a total timeout of 60 seconds
- Added persistent service logs, so you can now inspect recent startup and shutdown records after a service restart and include them in app log exports
- Improved page loading feedback, which now uses a continuous forward animation
- Improved settings section headings on acrylic backgrounds, which now use clearer text colors
- Changed how card backgrounds look in dark acrylic mode; they now use 80% opacity

---

- 对托盘打开窗口的速度进行了改善，窗口与后台现在共用一个进程，显示响应更快
- 对隐藏窗口后的内存占用进行了改善，隐藏五秒后释放图形资源，同时保留页面供再次打开
- 修复了恢复隐藏窗口时关闭按钮短暂闪现旧悬停颜色的问题
- 修复了较慢服务器的远程订阅下载过早超时的问题，现在整个下载过程的超时时间为 60 秒
- 新增了持久化服务日志，现在可以在服务重启后查看近期启动和关闭记录，并随应用日志一同导出
- 对页面加载提示进行了改善，现在使用连续向前的动画
- 对亚克力背景上的设置分组标题进行了改善，现在采用更清晰的文字颜色
- 调整了深色亚克力模式下的卡片背景，现在采用 80% 不透明度
